facts.text: John shared a picture of his family, who motivate him and remind him why he is doing his work.

evidence.quote: Here's a picture of my family. They motivate me and remind me why I'm doing this.
That picture was from a trip we took last year for my daughter Sara's birthday - so much fun and good memories! My family motivates me to keep striving for change.

facts.text: Maria expressed admiration for the picture and suggested that the trip was incredible, noting that John's family obviously motivate and support him.

evidence.quote: That picture is awesome! Your family looks so stoked - your trip must have been incredible! They obviously motivate and support you.

facts.text: John mentioned that his family is his motivation and keeps him going, especially during difficult times.

evidence.quote: I sometimes doubt if I'm making a difference, but knowing there's people who understand my work means a lot and helps keep me going.
When times get hard, I look at it and remember why I'm doing what I'm doing. My family is my motivation and they keep me going.

facts.text: Maria acknowledged that memories and motivators help keep people on track and going.

evidence.quote: Memories and motivators definitely help us stay on track and keep us going.
